reasons: Direction is correct: Corio is the customer-side party (licensee) and Commerce One the vendor; the inserted Section 8.3 adds vendor-side obligations only and does not create or broaden any Corio indemnity.

Deviation characterisation is accurate: Section 8.1 already supplies a vendor IP indemnity with notice/tender/cooperation procedure, customary exclusions (8.2) and procure/modify/replace/terminate remedies (fallback met), while the preferred limbs (breach of law, vendor-caused unauthorized access/disclosure of data, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and affiliate coverage are genuinely absent.

Edit is minimal and well placed: a single new Section 8.3 appended after the Section 8.2 limitations, expressly incorporating the Section 8.1 notice/defence/cooperation procedure rather than rewriting the existing indemnity.

The failed deterministic check ('vendor indemnity for IP infringement present') is an artifact of the regex being applied to the edited paragraph p0088 (the limitations clause); the IP indemnity remains intact in p0086 and is untouched, so the check does not indicate a substantive defect.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, states what was added and why, and offers a sensible fallback (accepting Section 9 treatment for the new limbs).
